lane:
جنك

جَنْكٌ [and جُنْكٌ] _A certain_ [_musical_] _instrument, which is beaten like the_ عُود [or _lute;_ namely, the _Persian harp;_ two specimens of which are figured in Note 26 to Chap. iii. of my translation of the “Thousand and One Nights”]; mentioned by El-Khafájee in the Shifá el-Ghaleel; and often spoken of: it is an arabicized word; (MF, TA;) from the Persian چَنْگ: and applied [also] to the دفّ, [دُفّ or دَفّ, i. e., _tambourine,_] _with which one plays._ (TA.)

جنكى جَنْكِىٌّ [and جُنْكِىٌّ] _A player on the_ جنك _above mentioned._ (TA.)
